title_zh: Anthropic 提交 IPO 申请，拟以「ANT」登陆纳斯达克
content_zh:
Anthropic 10 月 26 日向美国证监会公开提交 S-1 注册文件，计划在纳斯达克以「ANT」为代码上市。公司称，拟发行股数和价格区间尚未确定，注册文件也尚未生效。

招股书披露，今年上半年营收为 162.86 亿美元，去年同期为 11.63 亿美元；GAAP 净亏损为 807.48 亿美元。其中，可转债、衍生负债及未来股权简单协议的公允价值变动造成 723.88 亿美元损失，主要与公司估值上升有关，不能等同于同期现金消耗。

经营层面的亏损为 6.93 亿美元。剔除股权激励、非现金慈善捐赠等项目后，经调整经营利润为 16.18 亿美元，属于非 GAAP 口径。

文件同时提示，未来收入增长可能放缓，算力和基础设施扩张会继续带来成本压力；高度自主的 AI 系统若被滥用或缺少适当防护，也可能造成灾难性风险。公司创始人实体持有的特殊 F 类股份，将拥有一般股东表决事项 50.1% 的投票权。

🔗 相关阅读：突发！Anthropic 公开上市申请，史上最大 IPO 要来了
title_en: Anthropic Files for Nasdaq IPO Under Ticker "ANT"
content_en:
AI powerhouse Anthropic has officially filed its S-1 registration statement with the U.S. SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT." The number of shares to be offered and the proposed price range have not yet been determined.

According to the prospectus, Anthropic generated $16.29 billion in revenue during the first half of this year, a dramatic leap from $1.16 billion in the same period last year. The company reported a GAAP net loss of $80.75 billion, largely driven by a $72.39 billion non-cash accounting loss from fair value adjustments on convertible notes reflecting its surging valuation. Its actual operating loss stood at $693 million, while adjusted non-GAAP operating profit reached $1.62 billion.

The filing also outlines key risk factors, noting that future revenue growth could slow and infrastructure costs will continue to exert financial pressure. It further highlighted potential risks associated with highly autonomous AI systems. Additionally, special Class F shares held by the founders will grant them 50.1% voting power over general corporate matters.

title_zh: 5499 元起，iPad mini 8 发布，仍无高刷
content_zh:
昨晚，苹果在官网低调上线新款 iPad mini，换用 8.5 英寸 OLED 超视网膜 XDR 显示屏与 A20 Pro 芯片，机身薄至 5.4 毫米，无线局域网版重 255 克。屏幕升级后仍不支持 120Hz ProMotion 高刷新率。

新机的主要变化包括：

新款提供午夜色与星光色，128GB 无线局域网版 5499 元起，蜂窝版 6799 元起，10 月 28 日接受订购，11 月 6 日发售。同步推出的科技织物智能双面夹售价 599 元，支持 Apple Pencil Pro 与 USB-C 版 Apple Pencil。

🔗 相关阅读：新 iPad mini 发布：5499 元起！应有尽有，除了高刷
title_en: Apple Unveils iPad mini 8 with OLED Display and A20 Pro Chip, Still Lacks 120Hz Support
content_en:
Apple has quietly updated its lineup with the launch of the new iPad mini. The refreshed tablet features an 8.5-inch OLED Super Retina XDR display and is powered by the A20 Pro chip. Measuring just 5.4 mm thin, the Wi-Fi model weighs 255 grams. Despite the major screen upgrade, it notably still lacks Apple's 120Hz ProMotion high refresh rate.

Available in Midnight and Starlight, pricing starts at 5,499 RMB for the 128GB Wi-Fi version and 6,799 RMB for the cellular model. Pre-orders begin on October 28, with full availability on November 6. Apple also introduced a matching Smart Folio case for 599 RMB, compatible with both the Apple Pencil Pro and the USB-C Apple Pencil.

title_zh: 苹果回应 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂：少量设备受影响，可联系 AppleCare 换机
content_zh:
苹果首次回应 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂投诉。在发给媒体的声明中，苹果表示已注意到少量 iPhone Duo 的内屏存在问题，遇到显示异常的用户应联系 AppleCare 更换设备。

苹果还表示，绝大多数设备不受影响，问题机型通常在使用初期就会显现故障。

据苹果员工透露，公司尚未向零售门店和客服人员下发正式指引，但已有团队展开调查，部分工程师正设法回收受影响设备进行分析。

此前，部分用户在 Reddit 等论坛上传了内屏沿铰链中线开裂的照片。iFixit 拆解提出过部件可能向屏幕施加过大压力的推测。
title_en: Apple Addresses iPhone Duo Screen Cracking Concerns, Offers Replacements via AppleCare
content_en:
Apple has issued its first official response to user complaints regarding inner screen cracking on the iPhone Duo. In a statement, the company acknowledged that a small number of devices have experienced display issues and advised affected users to reach out to AppleCare for a unit replacement.

Apple emphasized that the vast majority of devices are unaffected and noted that display flaws typically appear early in use. According to internal sources, while formal service guidelines have not yet been issued to retail stores, engineering teams have launched an investigation and are retrieving affected units for detailed analysis.

The official response follows reports on community platforms like Reddit, where users shared photos of inner displays cracking along the hinge. Early teardowns by repair site iFixit suggested that internal structural components might be exerting excessive pressure on the flexible panel.

title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，API 价格减半、电脑操作提速
content_zh:
OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，主打视觉理解、电脑操作和自然写作，已向 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 的 Plus、Pro、Enterprise 和 Edu 用户开放，开发者可通过 API 调用。

OpenAI 表示，新模型标准 API 价格比 GPT-5.6 Terra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 低 50%：每百万输入 Token 为 1 美元、缓存输入为 0.05 美元、输出为 5 美元。

在包含建筑图纸转 3D 模型等专业任务的 Agents」 Last Exam 测试中，Terra 在中等推理强度下比上一代高出 15 个百分点，成绩与 GPT-6 Astra 相当；官方称，完成电脑操作任务的速度超过 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 3 倍。

编程方面，Terra 在最高推理强度下的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 通过率为 50.3%，上一代公开成绩为 21.5%。OpenAI 仍将 Sol 和 Astra 列为最复杂编程任务的优先选择。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，GPT-6.1 Terra 骨折价发布，Agent 时代的打工模型来了
title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra featuring 50% Lower API Pricing and Faster Computer Operation
content_en:
OpenAI has officially released GPT-6.1 Terra, a new model focused on enhanced visual understanding, computer-use capabilities, and natural writing. The model is now available to ChatGPT Work and Codex subscribers (including Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu tiers), as well as developers via the API.

The update brings a major price reduction. Standard API pricing for GPT-6.1 Terra is 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol, set at $1.00 per million input tokens, $0.05 for cached inputs, and $5.00 per million output tokens.

In terms of performance, OpenAI reports that GPT-6.1 Terra performs computer-use tasks more than three times faster than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. On specialized benchmarks like Agents' Last Exam, Terra showed a 15-percentage-point improvement over the previous generation. In coding benchmarks, it achieved a 50.3% pass rate on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (up from 21.5%), though OpenAI still recommends Sol and Astra for the most complex programming tasks.

title_zh: 苹果正式推送 iOS 27.2：Apple Music 迎来黑白新设计、iPhone Duo 支持 Apple Pencil
content_zh:
今天凌晨，苹果正式推送了 iOS 27.2 更新，针对多项原生应用进行设计调整，并扩展了 Siri 的语言支持。

在视觉与界面设计上，Apple Music 图标由传统的红色调整为黑白设计，选中的标签页强调色也由红色替换为蓝色，同时推出了黑色背景的音乐小组件。

本次更新还为 iPhone Duo 增加了对 Apple Pencil（USB-C）的支持。

在功能层面，Siri AI 语言能力得到进一步扩展，新增支持法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语等 5 种语言。

其他原生应用与功能也迎来了相应改进。

智能家居方面，兼容的智能门锁新增了「关闭后自动上锁」和「开门过久提醒」选项，HomePod 更新后也已支持「锁定控制」。
title_en: Apple Releases iOS 27.2 with Redesigned Apple Music, iPhone Duo Pencil Support, and Expanded Siri AI
content_en:
Apple has officially rolled out iOS 27.2, introducing visual updates to native apps, new smart home features, and expanded language capabilities for Siri.

Visual updates include a redesign of Apple Music, featuring a new black-and-white app icon, blue accent highlights on selected tabs, and a new dark-themed music widget. Additionally, the update adds support for the Apple Pencil (USB-C) on the iPhone Duo.

On the functional side, Siri AI now supports five new languages: French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. Smart home enhancements bring auto-locking and prolonged open-door alerts to compatible smart locks, along with new lock controls for HomePod.

title_zh: 华为畅享系列累计发货突破 1.6 亿台，畅享 100 将于 10 月 28 日发布
content_zh:
华为董事、终端 BG CEO 何刚 10 月 26 日发文表示，华为畅享系列走过 11 年，累计发货量已突破 1.6 亿台。他将耐用可靠和续航持久列为用户选择这一系列的原因，并感谢用户长期使用。

新一代畅享 100 系列将于 10 月 28 日 14:30 发布。此次公布的 1.6 亿台是畅享整个系列的累计发货口径，覆盖多代产品，不是畅享 100 的订单量或销量。
title_en: Huawei Enjoy Series Tops 160 Million Shipments Ahead of Enjoy 100 Launch
content_en:
Huawei Terminal BG CEO He Gang announced that cumulative shipments for the Huawei Enjoy series have surpassed 160 million units over the past 11 years. He credited the series' success to its reputation for durability, reliability, and long battery life.

Following the announcement, Huawei confirmed that the next-generation Enjoy 100 series will officially launch on October 28 at 14:30. The company noted that the 160-million milestone reflects total shipments across all generations of the Enjoy lineup to date.

title_zh: 小鹏悠游获批 L4 级示范运营，初期仍凭邀请码体验
content_zh:
小鹏 Robotaxi 取得广州市智能网联汽车应用示范运营资格，可在广州全域开展 L4 级示范运营。南都·湾财社 10 月 26 日从小鹏集团获悉，初期「小鹏悠游」仍将通过邀请码逐步开放体验，并稳步扩大服务范围。

这是在道路测试和员工内测之后，面向真实出行服务的一次准入推进。今年 5 月，小鹏首台 Robotaxi 量产车下线；7 月打通线上下单、自动接驾至送达的全链路；8 月取得广州主驾无安全员道路测试资质。10 月，业务定名「小鹏悠游 XPENG YOYO」，打车小程序同步上线。

小鹏悠游基于小鹏 GX 打造，搭载 4 颗自研图灵 AI 芯片和第二代 VLA 大模型。何小鹏此前表示，业务定位是向合作伙伴提供整车平台、自动驾驶软件和 AI 能力，由伙伴承担当地车队运营，收入来自硬件销售、技术服务与佣金分成。
title_en: XPeng's Robotaxi 'YOYO' Approved for L4 Demonstration Operations in Guangzhou
content_en:
XPeng's autonomous taxi service, "XPeng YOYO," has officially secured approval to launch Level 4 (L4) driverless demonstration operations across all of Guangzhou. Initial public access will be rolled out gradually via invitation codes.

Built on the XPeng GX platform, the vehicle features four in-house developed Turing AI chips and XPeng's second-generation VLA large model. This milestone follows a series of operational advances, including initial mass production in May, full-chain ride-hailing integration in July, and driverless road testing permits in August.

XPeng Chairman He Xiaopeng stated that the company plans to provide vehicle platforms, autonomous driving software, and AI capabilities to operating partners who will manage local fleets. XPeng will generate revenue through hardware sales, technology services, and commission splits.

title_zh: DeepSeek Flash 1017 登顶 OpenRouter 周用量榜，处理 33.6 万亿 Token
content_zh:
OpenRouter 截至 10 月 25 日的最近一周用量榜显示，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 处理了 33.6 万亿 Token，环比增长 801%，位居第一。

榜单第二至第五名依次为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、MiniMax M3.1 Flash 免费版、GLM 5.3 Flash 和腾讯 Hy4 preview，处理量分别为 18 万亿、13.7 万亿、13.2 万亿和 8.97 万亿 Token。

这份榜单统计经 OpenRouter API 处理的输入与输出 Token，排除用户或应用选择保密的请求，同一模型的不同变体单独排名。它反映平台内的使用量，不涵盖全球各厂商直连服务，也不是准确率或推理能力榜。

OpenRouter 另按文本请求次数统计厂商份额：在 10 月 19 日开始的一周，DeepSeek 占比为 26.5%，同样排名第一。请求次数占比与 Token 总量是两项不同指标。
title_en: DeepSeek Tops OpenRouter Weekly Usage Rankings with 33.6 Trillion Tokens Processed
content_en:
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 claimed the top spot on OpenRouter's weekly usage leaderboard for the week ending October 25, processing a massive 33.6 trillion tokens—an 801% surge week-over-week.

Other leading models on the chart included DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (18 trillion tokens), MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free (13.7 trillion), GLM 5.3 Flash (13.2 trillion), and Tencent’s Hy4 preview (8.97 trillion).

OpenRouter noted that the ranking tracks API input and output token usage on its platform, excluding private requests and direct vendor traffic. DeepSeek also led in text request volume during the week of October 19, capturing a 26.5% market share on the platform.

title_zh: SK 海力士回应特别股息传闻：方案未定，拟于 28 日公布股东回报安排
content_zh:
据韩国 Edaily 报道，SK 海力士 10 月 26 日回应特别股息传闻称，公司正研究多种提升股东价值的回报方案，目前尚未确定；拟在董事会决议后，于 10 月 28 日发布第三季度业绩时披露新增安排。

此前有韩媒称，SK 海力士考虑利用出售日本存储厂商铠侠股权所得收益，派发约 16 万亿韩元特别股息。

SK 海力士此前已宣布 40 万亿韩元的股份回购及全额注销计划。Edaily 报道称，回购于 10 月 21 日提前完成，所购股份将全数注销。
title_en: SK Hynix Clarifies Special Dividend Rumors, Set to Announce Shareholder Plan on Oct 28
content_en:
SK Hynix has responded to market rumors regarding a potential special dividend, stating that while various options to enhance shareholder value are under review, no final decisions have been made. The memory chipmaker plans to unveil its updated shareholder return strategy following board approval during its third-quarter earnings release on October 28.

The response follows local media speculation that SK Hynix might payout a special dividend of approximately 16 trillion won using proceeds from the sale of its stake in Japanese chipmaker Kioxia.

Separately, SK Hynix completed a 40 trillion won share buyback program ahead of schedule on October 21. All repurchased shares will be fully canceled as part of its ongoing capital strategy.

title_zh: Kimi 为 K3.1 Pro 限流致歉并重置额度
content_zh:
Kimi 昨日就 K3.1 Pro 订阅计划中出现的限流和不必要的额度消耗公开致歉，并宣布对所有套餐的订阅用户做一次性用量重置。

Kimi 官方在 X 上表示，这些问题「出在我们」，本应更早修复。补偿方案是：所有套餐的每位订阅用户恢复月度额度的 25%，相当于一周用量。

当前用量低于 25% 的，直接重置为零。Kimi 还称，已调整套餐参数，正在减少不必要的子智能体调用和输出长度，让同样的额度完成更多实际任务。

此次事件发生在 K3.1 Pro 发布两天后。该模型的升级重点之一是金融研究，Kimi 内部测试显示，其金融建模得分由 K3 的 50.4 升至 57.6，金融研究得分由 58.8 升至 70.4。
title_en: Kimi Apologizes for K3.1 Pro Rate-Limiting Issues, Announces Quota Resets
content_en:
AI platform Kimi has issued a public apology following widespread rate-limiting issues and unintended quota depletion associated with its newly released K3.1 Pro subscription plan.

To compensate affected users, Kimi announced a one-time usage reset across all subscription tiers. Every subscriber will receive a 25% restoration of their monthly allowance—roughly equivalent to one week of usage—while accounts with less than 25% usage will have their counters reset to zero.

Acknowledging the oversight on X, Kimi admitted the fault lay on their side and pledged better responsiveness. The company has adjusted its backend parameters to reduce unnecessary sub-agent calls and trim output length, helping users accomplish more with the same quota.

The disruption occurred just two days after the rollout of K3.1 Pro, an upgraded model tailored for financial research that significantly improved internal benchmark scores in financial modeling and analysis.

title_zh: 奥迪中国明确品牌分工：一汽主攻四环，上汽聚焦 AUDI 字母标
content_zh:
奥迪在中国的两套品牌体系有了更清晰的分工。10 月 26 日，据第一财经记者武子晔报道，奥迪分别与中国一汽、上汽集团签署战略协议，明确四环品牌与 AUDI 字母标品牌的差异化定位，以及「双品牌、双合作伙伴」渠道架构。

中国一汽将强化奥迪四环品牌在智能豪华新能源车型和燃油车型两个领域的布局；上汽奥迪则聚焦 AUDI 字母标品牌，专注新能源市场，开发面向中国消费者的下一代智能网联汽车。

过渡期内，上汽奥迪仍可在 2027 年底前正常销售四环产品。上汽奥迪旗下既有四环产品，以及 AUDI 字母标产品的售后服务均将保持平稳运营。
title_en: Audi Clarifies Dual-Partner Strategy in China: FAW Leads Four Rings, SAIC Focuses on 'AUDI' Brand
content_en:
Audi China has established a clearer division of labor for its dual-partner network in China after signing strategic agreements with FAW Group and SAIC Motor on October 26.

Under the refined strategy, FAW-Audi will reinforce the traditional four-ring brand across both smart luxury new energy vehicles (NEVs) and internal combustion engine (ICE) lineups. In contrast, SAIC-Audi will focus on the newly introduced "AUDI" lettermark brand, targeting the NEV sector with next-generation intelligent connected vehicles tailored specifically for Chinese consumers.

During a transition period lasting through the end of 2027, SAIC-Audi will continue to sell four-ring models. Customer support and after-sales services for both four-ring and lettermark vehicles under SAIC will remain unaffected.

title_zh: 大众中国获得 L3 路测牌照，已在合肥启动实路测试
content_zh:
大众汽车集团（中国）宣布，已在合肥获得 L3 级自动驾驶道路测试牌照，并启动真实道路测试与数据采集。

大众中国 10 月 26 日发布的公告称，这次获牌是向 2027 年实现 L3 级自动驾驶技术就绪迈进的一步。本次公布的范围为道路测试，集团给出的 2027 年节点也是技术就绪目标。

10 月 28 日，首届大众汽车集团（中国）技术日将在合肥举行，集中展示最新技术进展。
title_en: Volkswagen Secures L3 Autonomous Driving Test License in Hefei, China
content_en:
Volkswagen Group (China) has secured a Level 3 (L3) autonomous driving road testing permit in Hefei, Anhui Province, allowing the automaker to initiate real-world road tests and data collection.

According to the company, obtaining the license represents a key milestone toward achieving technical readiness for commercial L3 autonomous driving by 2027.

The development comes just ahead of the inaugural Volkswagen Group (China) Technology Day on October 28 in Hefei, where the automaker plans to demonstrate its latest technological achievements.

title_zh: Anthropic 确认部分内部系统遭研究人员访问，客户对话与模型权重未受影响
content_zh:
据《华盛顿邮报》10 月 26 日报道，网络安全初创公司 Cathedral 在 Anthropic 的外部安全测试计划下，利用第三方企业软件漏洞进入其内部系统。Cathedral 的报告草稿称，AI 智能体运行不到 12 小时，就找到了访问会议实录、薪酬与录用信息，以及部分讨论模型的 Slack 消息的路径。

Anthropic 确认，研究人员访问了销售、人力资源和 IT 系统中的有限部分，涉及部分客户与合作伙伴的商业联系信息，以及基本账户记录；客户发给模型的消息、模型回复、AI 系统代码和模型权重均未被访问。

公司称，监控系统在 Cathedral 报告前已发现部分活动，并于当天切断访问；目前没有证据显示其他人利用了这些漏洞。涉事企业软件被停用，供应商确认修复后才重新启用。

双方对测试过程仍有分歧。Anthropic 认为 Cathedral 夸大了国家安全影响，且未完整披露在系统内的活动；Cathedral 则称已遵循安全研究惯例，把数据访问限制在必要的最低程度。
title_en: Anthropic Confirms Internal System Access by Researchers; Customer Chats and Model Weights Remain Unaffected
content_en:
Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic confirmed that external researchers briefly accessed limited internal systems via a third-party software vulnerability. The incident occurred during a security testing program conducted by cybersecurity startup Cathedral, whose AI agents discovered access routes to meeting transcripts, compensation details, and internal Slack discussions within 12 hours.

Anthropic clarified that the exposure was strictly confined to limited sales, HR, and IT systems, involving basic contact details for select customers and partners. Crucially, customer prompts, AI responses, core system code, and proprietary model weights were not compromised.

Anthropic's internal monitoring detected the activity and severed access on the same day before Cathedral submitted its report. The third-party software was suspended until the vendor applied a patch. While Cathedral stated it followed standard research practices to minimize data exposure, Anthropic contended that the firm exaggerated the national security impact and failed to fully disclose its system activities.

title_zh: Cadence 推出 Maestro 芯片设计模型，可在客户防火墙内运行
content_zh:
芯片设计软件公司 Cadence 发布 Maestro AI 模型组合，用于驱动旗下芯片与系统设计智能体。模型可部署在 Cadence 云、公共云，也可放在客户自己的数据中心和防火墙内运行。

Maestro 部分采用英伟达开放权重 Nemotron 模型，并结合 OpenShell 安全技术；客户可以用自己的芯片设计数据微调。Cadence 将模型、强化学习流程与 EDA 设计工具连接起来，依据工程结果持续优化设计决策。

公司称，初期设计流程测试较通用基础模型实现最高 30% 的质量提升、最高 5 倍 Token 使用效率；这些是其早期测试结果。首批模型计划于第四季度向部分早期客户开放。Cadence 高级副总裁 Paul Cunningham 向路透社表示，Maestro 同时考虑开放和封闭权重模型路线。
title_en: Cadence Unveils Maestro AI Models for Secure, On-Premises Chip Design
content_en:
Electronic design automation (EDA) leader Cadence has launched Maestro, a new portfolio of AI models designed to power autonomous chip and system design agents. To address strict data privacy demands, Maestro can be deployed on Cadence Cloud, public clouds, or directly within a customer's private data center and firewall.

Built in part on Nvidia's open-weights Nemotron models and integrated with OpenShell security technology, Maestro enables clients to fine-tune the system using their proprietary design data. By linking foundation models and reinforcement learning directly with EDA tools, the solution continuously optimizes engineering decisions based on real-time feedback.

Early testing indicates that Maestro achieves up to a 30% improvement in design quality and up to a 5x increase in token efficiency compared to general-purpose foundation models. Initial rollouts are scheduled for select early-access customers in the fourth quarter.

title_zh: 微软向约 6 万名员工提供自愿离职方案，最迟 12 月初决定
content_zh:
据 Business Insider 查看员工方案并获得微软确认，微软向约 6 万名员工提供自愿离职补偿，覆盖美国、加拿大、英国和印度部分团队。符合条件的人数不代表最终离职人数；员工可在 12 月初前决定是否接受，并于年底离开。

补偿按职级、地区和任职年限分别计算。该媒体查看的美国方案中，64 级及以下员工每任职半年可获一周基本工资，65 至 67 级每半年可获两周基本工资；67 级及以下标准补偿上限为 39 周基本工资。

方案还包括继续归属的股票和医疗保险，其中 67 级及以下员工的标准股票归属期按工龄分为 6 个月或 12 个月。微软发言人表示，目前没有再次推出同类自愿离职方案的计划。
title_en: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to Nearly 60,000 Employees Globally
content_en:
Microsoft is offering voluntary separation packages to approximately 60,000 employees across select teams in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and India. Eligible workers have until early December to decide whether to accept the buyout, with departures targeted for the end of the year.

Severance terms vary by job level, location, and length of service. Under the U.S. guidelines, employees at level 64 and below receive one week of base pay for every six months of service, while levels 65 through 67 receive two weeks per six months, capped at a maximum of 39 weeks of base salary.

The buyout offer also includes ongoing healthcare coverage and continued stock vesting for 6 to 12 months based on tenure. A Microsoft spokesperson confirmed that the company has no immediate plans to introduce similar voluntary separation programs in the future.

title_zh: Meta 启动约 350 亿美元股权融资，另拟推出 600 亿美元售股计划
content_zh:
Meta 10 月 26 日宣布启动两项公开发行，合计约 350 亿美元，包括约 225 亿美元 A 类普通股，以及代表强制可转换优先股的约 125 亿美元存托股份。公司称，这些安排将支持 AI 基础设施及「个人超级智能」投入。

另一项约 600 亿美元的按市价售股计划，拟在新设 C 类普通股开始交易后启动，预计不早于 2027 年第一季度。两部分基础规模合计约 950 亿美元；未来计划尚未签署协议，实际启动时间、规模和条款仍未确定。

英伟达、AMD 和博通各表达了购买至多 50 亿美元本次普通股的意向，但均不具约束力，实际购买额可能调整。

这笔融资也分阶段到账。A 类普通股发行采用远期销售协议，Meta 初期不会直接取得该部分售股款，而将在未来结算时获得资金。公司表示，将以经营现金流、投资级债务、战略合作和股权资本共同支持算力建设。
title_en: Meta Launches $35B Capital Raise for AI Infrastructure, Eyes Further $60B Share Plan
content_en:
Meta has initiated two public offerings totaling approximately $35 billion to fund its expanding AI infrastructure and the development of "personal superintelligence." The capital raise includes roughly $22.5 billion in Class A common stock and $12.5 billion in depositary shares representing mandatory convertible preferred stock.

Looking further ahead, Meta plans to launch a $60 billion at-the-market stock offering program no earlier than the first quarter of 2027, coinciding with the launch of a new Class C share structure. Key semiconductor partners—Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom—have each expressed non-binding interest to acquire up to $5 billion in common stock.

Funds from the Class A offering will be delivered in phases through forward sale agreements. Meta noted it will support its massive compute buildout through a combination of operating cash flow, investment-grade debt, strategic partnerships, and equity capital.

title_zh: SpaceX 获约 400 亿美元 GPU 融资承诺，将租赁英伟达 Vera Rubin 设备
content_zh:
SpaceX 10 月 26 日公布，与阿波罗全球管理公司管理的实体达成约 400 亿美元 GPU 及相关设备主融资租赁的约束性承诺，用于扩建地面算力基础设施。设备将包括英伟达下一代 Vera Rubin 芯片。

这笔融资由阿波罗与高盛牵头，高盛担任独家结构设计代理；贝莱德、高盛资产管理旗下基金及账户，以及 KKR 提供顾问服务的资本账户也作出核心投资承诺。

交易仍须满足约定交割条件，预计在 2026 年底前完成，具体租赁安排预计随 GPU 和相关设备于 2027 年上半年交付后启动。

SpaceX 表示，新增算力将支持面向企业与消费者的 Grok，以及现有和未来的云服务客户；租赁融资也是其分散资金来源、加快算力部署计划的一部分。
title_en: SpaceX Secures $40B Lease Financing for Next-Gen Nvidia AI Chips
content_en:
SpaceX has secured a binding $40 billion master lease financing commitment led by Apollo Global Management and Goldman Sachs to expand its ground computing infrastructure. The facility will fund the procurement of Nvidia’s next-generation Vera Rubin GPUs and related equipment.

The financing consortium includes major commitments from BlackRock, Goldman Sachs Asset Management funds, and accounts advised by KKR. The transaction is expected to close by late 2026, with leasing arrangements kicking off alongside hardware deliveries in the first half of 2027.

SpaceX stated that the expanded capacity will support both enterprise and consumer versions of Grok, as well as its growing cloud operations. The master lease structure allows the company to diversify its capital sources while accelerating compute deployment.

title_zh: 💡 比尔·盖茨：AI 带来富足前，要先度过约 20 年的动荡
content_zh:
比尔·盖茨在 10 月 22 日播出的 Decoder 播客访谈中表示，AI 能够减少住房、食物和医疗等领域的短缺，但他更担心通往富足的约 20 年过渡期：其间会出现赢家、输家和大量冲击。

在盖茨看来，电话销售、客服和会计等白领岗位会先受到影响，人形机器人随后也可能改变体力劳动。工作同时提供收入、目标感、同事关系与解决问题的机会，单靠商品变便宜无法回答人们如何获得这些东西。

他以自己的慈善工作举例：即使组织资源消除疟疾曾是他的独特贡献，AI 也可能做得更好，把他打发去打匹克球。对希望作出独特贡献的年轻人来说，这种能力变化会带来压力。

盖茨提出，人类可以选择把育儿、烹饪、艺术和体育等领域保留给人来做，即使 AI 能做得更好；提前退休、缩短工作周也是可讨论的办法。这些安排需要社会作出政策选择。他认为，一部分人可能主动远离技术前沿，以保留互相帮助和作出独特贡献的空间。

他同时强调，20 年只是自己选取的一个相对稳妥的估计，实际时间可能更长或更短。如果不大幅放缓或停止 AI 发展，机器人将逐步承担建房、种植食物和手术等工作；人类需要决定如何安排富足时代的生活，而他当前的重点仍是如何度过这段转型期。
title_en: Bill Gates Warns of 20 Years of Turmoil Before AI Delivers Abundance
content_en:
Speaking on the *Decoder* podcast, Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates warned that while artificial intelligence will eventually eliminate scarcity in housing, healthcare, and food, society faces a turbulent 20-year transition period marked by economic disruption and shifting labor markets.

Gates noted that white-collar roles in accounting, customer service, and telemarketing will face early displacement, followed by manual labor as humanoid robotics mature. He highlighted that work provides purpose, community, and personal fulfillment—essential human needs that cannot be replaced simply by making goods cheaper.

To navigate this shift, Gates suggested that society could intentionally reserve certain human-centric fields—such as childcare, culinary arts, sports, and creative arts—or adopt policy solutions like shorter workweeks. He emphasized that managing this multi-decade transition smoothly remains one of humanity's most urgent challenges.

title_zh: 卢伟冰称 REDMI K100「同档无敌」，新配色雪岩白公布
content_zh:
REDMI K100 将于 10 月 27 日 19:00 发布。小米集团总裁卢伟冰 10 月 26 日发文预告，并称其「又是一款同档无敌的产品」。

REDMI 官方同日公布新配色「雪岩白」，机身背部采用宣纸般的细腻纹理，并已在各大电商平台开启预约。
title_en: Lu Weibing Hypes REDMI K100 as "Unbeatable" Ahead of Launch, New "Snow Rock White" Finish Revealed
content_en:
Xiaomi Group President Lu Weibing has teased the upcoming launch of the REDMI K100, scheduled for October 27 at 19:00, calling the new device "unbeatable in its class."

Ahead of the event, REDMI unveiled a new colorway dubbed "Snow Rock White," featuring a delicate back panel texture reminiscent of traditional rice paper. Pre-orders for the flagship smartphone are now open across major Chinese e-commerce platforms.

title_zh: 魏牌高山 8 HEV 上市，不插电油混版限时置换权益价 25.98 万元起
content_zh:
魏牌高山 8 HEV 于 10 月 26 日上市，推出舒享版和臻享版两款车型，官方售价分别为 26.58 万元、28.58 万元；汽车之家向魏牌官方取得的上市信息将限时置换权益价列为 25.98 万元、27.98 万元。

新车采用 2.0T 发动机与前后双电机组成的油电混动系统，全系标配 Hi4 四驱，配备 3.64kWh 电池，无需外接充电。系统综合最大功率为 322kW，峰值扭矩 782N·m，零百加速 5.9 秒，WLTC 综合油耗为 6.92L/100km。

车身长 5280mm、轴距 3145mm，采用三排七座布局，延续纯平地板和二、三排共轨设计。座舱使用 Coffee OS 3.5 与高通 8295P 芯片，支持 HiCar、Carlink 和 CarPlay。辅助驾驶系统为 Coffee Pilot 3，配置 192 线激光雷达、27 个传感器和 Orin-Y 芯片。
title_en: Wey Launches Gaoshan 8 HEV MPV with Trade-In Pricing Starting at 259,800 Yuan
content_en:
Great Wall Motor's premium Wey brand officially launched the Gaoshan 8 HEV on October 26, available in two trims priced at 265,800 yuan and 285,800 yuan. With a limited-time trade-in subsidy, effective starting prices drop to 259,800 yuan and 279,800 yuan, respectively.

The non-plug-in hybrid MPV features a 2.0T engine paired with dual electric motors, Wey's Hi4 four-wheel-drive system, and a 3.64 kWh battery pack. Delivering a combined system output of 322 kW and 782 N·m of torque, the vehicle accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 5.9 seconds, with a WLTC fuel consumption rating of 6.92 L/100 km.

Measuring 5,280 mm in length with a 3,145 mm wheelbase, the seven-seater MPV offers a flat-floor interior with shared sliding tracks for the second and third rows. The cockpit is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8295P chip running Coffee OS 3.5, while driver assistance is managed by the Coffee Pilot 3 system, equipped with a 192-line LiDAR sensor, 27 sensors, and an Nvidia Orin-Y chip.

title_zh: 无问芯穹与三体宇宙发布智子 Agent，可延续跨会话记忆
content_zh:
无问芯穹与三体宇宙于 10 月 25 日在北京举行的「2026 三体日·脱水浸泡嘉年华」上宣布战略合作，并发布首个合作产品「智子 Agent 1.0」。这款 AI 对话智能体以《三体》中的小宇宙管理员智子为角色锚点，支持多轮交流和跨会话记忆。

双方分工中，三体宇宙负责世界观设定、角色边界和人格特征；无问芯穹提供智能体开发、知识与记忆管理、推理服务等基础设施。产品基于 AgentWorks 平台构建，将世界观资料整理为可检索的知识库，通过分层提示词管理角色语气，并用 Infini Memory 延续不同会话之间的记忆。

据无问芯穹介绍，对话生成时，角色表达与世界观知识检索并行进行；初稿还要经过独立审校模块，排查人设偏离和设定越界，再把具体冲突送回修改。系统负责定位明确的事实偏差，角色表达是否贴合原作则由三体宇宙内容团队把关。

双方后续还将探索角色长期记忆与关系演进、多角色共享世界观叙事，以及多模态交互。
title_en: Infinigence AI and Three-Body Universe Launch Sophon Agent 1.0 Featuring Cross-Session Memory
content_en:
Infinigence AI and Three-Body Universe have announced a strategic partnership to launch Sophon Agent 1.0, an AI conversational agent modeled after Sophon from the acclaimed sci-fi franchise *The Three-Body Problem*. Unveiled on October 25, the agent supports multi-turn conversations and maintains memory across separate user sessions.

Under the collaboration, Three-Body Universe establishes the world-building, character boundaries, and personality traits, while Infinigence AI provides the underlying infrastructure, including agent architecture, memory management, and inference. Built on the AgentWorks platform, the system leverages Infini Memory technology to preserve continuity across conversations.

To ensure narrative accuracy, the platform runs lore retrieval alongside response generation, passing initial drafts through an auditing module to catch out-of-character behavior. Moving forward, both companies plan to explore dynamic long-term memory, shared narrative universes, and multimodal interactions.

title_zh: 老干妈否认「600 人裁至 48 人」，确认已应用 AI 质检
content_zh:
老干妈回应了「AI 质检上线后，拣椒工人从 600 余人减至 48 人」的传闻。据凤凰网《风暴眼》10 月 26 日报道，其记者致电老干妈人力资源部门，工作人员明确表示，网传人员调整内容为假消息。

该工作人员确认，AI 质检技术已在生产基地上线应用，但企业从未有过对应规模的人员调整安排，并称「从来都没有用过这么多工人」。
title_en: Lao Gan Ma Denies AI Quality Control Led to Mass Layoffs
content_en:
Chinese chili sauce giant Lao Gan Ma has debunked online rumors claiming that the implementation of AI quality control reduced its pepper-sorting workforce from over 600 employees down to just 48.

In a report published on October 26, the company's HR department clarified that while AI quality inspection technology has indeed been deployed at its production facilities, no large-scale staff reductions ever took place. The representative further noted that the company has never employed that many pepper sorters to begin with.

title_zh: ROG ×《影之刃零》首批联名硬件开售，武侠设计覆盖主机与外设
content_zh:
ROG 与灵游坊 S-GAME 合作推出的《影之刃零》首批联名硬件于 10 月 26 日 10:00 开售，覆盖迷你主机、显示器、键盘、耳机、鼠标和键帽包。

官方产品页将黑红配色、刀刃纹理、武器雕刻、角色剪影与绯红血线融入硬件外观。NUC 16 联名迷你主机的半透明前面板印有主角「魂」的剪影，支架可以拆卸，支持横放和竖放。

NUC 16 联名版可选配酷睿 Ultra 9 290HX 处理器及 RTX 5080 笔记本电脑 GPU，采用三风扇和一体式均热板，支持免工具升级内存与固态硬盘。游民星空报道，联名机箱将于 10 月 29 日单独开售；购买指定产品并完成官网登记，可参与数量有限的游戏兑换码赠送活动。
title_en: ROG Partners with 'Phantom Blade Zero' to Launch Wuxia-Themed Gaming Hardware
content_en:
Asus ROG, in collaboration with game developer S-GAME, officially launched its first batch of co-branded gaming hardware themed after the upcoming action title *Phantom Blade Zero* on October 26. The collection spans a wide range of devices, including a mini PC, gaming monitor, keyboard, headset, mouse, and keycaps.

The hardware features a distinct dark martial arts aesthetic, incorporating a black-and-red color scheme, blade textures, weapon engravings, and character silhouettes. A highlight of the lineup is the ROG NUC 16 mini PC, which boasts a semi-transparent front panel displaying the protagonist's silhouette, a tool-less upgrade design, and high-end specs powered by up to an Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX processor and an RTX 5080 laptop GPU.

Additionally, a standalone co-branded PC chassis will be available starting October 29. Customers purchasing select products can also register on the official website to claim limited game redemption codes.

title_zh: 大众点评内测「生活家」：找店、打卡和互动也能攒成长分
content_zh:
大众点评正在部分城市内测「生活家」用户成长体系。界面新闻 10 月 26 日从多位用户处获悉，并经记者测试确认，合肥、郑州、福州等地部分用户已能在 App「我的」页面看到入口。

与原有主要依靠发布评价积分的 Lv 体系相比，「生活家」覆盖更多日常行为。评价、笔记、打卡、大众评审、地点标记与贡献信息均可获得成长分，找店、点赞、回复他人评价等互动也被纳入；计划强调足迹记录，以及帮助其他用户发现好去处。

新体系共设 1 至 18 级，权益除免费试、到店礼外，还包括打车券、券包等。长期保持评价和记录习惯的老用户，在新体系中的等级通常也较高。此次为部分城市灰测，尚非全量用户切换。
title_en: Dianping Beta Tests New 'Life Expert' Growth System Rewarding Daily User Engagement
content_en:
Dianping, China's leading local lifestyle review platform, is currently testing a new user growth system dubbed "Life Expert" in select cities, including Hefei, Zhengzhou, and Fuzhou.

Unlike the platform's traditional tier system that primarily relies on publishing detailed reviews, the "Life Expert" model expands rewardable actions to include broader daily activities. Users can now earn growth points by searching for venues, checking in, tagging locations, liking posts, and replying to comments.

The new system features 18 tiers, unlocking rewards such as free product trials, in-store gifts, and discount vouchers. Long-time users who consistently log their activity will start at higher levels in the new system, which is undergoing regional testing before a potential full rollout.

title_zh: 《三星堆：未来往事》上映第四天票房约 119 万元，博纳影业股价跌停
content_zh:
AI 深度参与制作的院线长片《三星堆：未来往事》10 月 23 日上映后，首个周末的市场表现偏冷。据《每日经济新闻》援引猫眼专业版数据，截至 10 月 26 日午间，这部 100 分钟影片的累计综合票房为 119.2 万元，24 日、25 日场均观影人数均约 2 人。

26 日午间页面显示，当日排片 8469 场，上座率约 0.1%。同一天，制作方博纳影业股价跌停，收盘跌幅为 10.06%。此前，公司曾于 9 月 28 日、10 月 9 日和 12 日三个交易日涨停。

博纳影业已在 10 月 12 日的股票交易异常波动公告中提示，该片票房收益存在不确定性。公司另一部 AI 院线电影《计划外：广寒行动》已进入制作阶段，截至该公告披露日尚未取得公映许可证，也未正式定档。
title_en: AI Feature Film "Sanxingdui" Flops at Box Office, Sending Producer Bona Film's Stock to Daily Low
content_en:
The heavily AI-assisted feature film *Sanxingdui: Future Past* met a chilly reception during its opening weekend following its October 23 debut. According to industry tracking data, the 100-minute movie gathered just 1.19 million yuan (approx. $167,000) by noon on October 26, averaging roughly two viewers per screening with an seat occupancy rate of just 0.1%.

The disappointing box office performance led to a steep decline in the stock price of its production company, Bona Film Group, which hit the 10% daily limit down on October 26. The fall stands in stark contrast to the stock's multiple limit-up surges earlier in late September and October.

Bona Film had previously issued announcements warning investors of financial uncertainties surrounding the film's revenue. Meanwhile, the studio's next AI theatrical project, *Unplanned: Operation Guanghan*, remains in production and has yet to obtain a public screening license or announce a release date.

title_zh: 2026《鸿蒙星光盛典》定档 12 月 5 日
content_zh:
2026《鸿蒙星光盛典》将于 12 月 5 日在深圳湾体育中心「春茧」体育场举办。央视新闻于 10 月 26 日发布官宣海报，宣布这场科技与文艺结合的活动再度举行。

央视频同步发布了盛典预告视频，将去年的「在一起，就可以」与今年的「在一起，向未来」相衔接。官方把本届活动定位为科技与文艺的再次相逢，希望以盛典呈现鸿蒙生态中创造者与用户的共同参与，以及应用体验的发展。
title_en: 2026 HarmonyOS Starlight Gala Set for December 5 in Shenzhen
content_en:
The 2026 HarmonyOS Starlight Gala will take place on December 5 at the "Spring Cocoon" Stadium within the Shenzhen Bay Sports Center. CCTV News officially announced the date on October 26 with the release of promotional posters and teaser videos, marking another event that bridges technology with culture and performance art.

Building upon last year's theme of "Together, We Can," this year's slogan advances to "Together, Towards the Future." The event aims to spotlight the vibrant ecosystem of HarmonyOS, showcasing the shared journey between creators and users alongside advancements in application experiences.

title_zh: 路阳监制电影《试探》定档 11 月 21 日，发布新预告
content_zh:
电影《试探》宣布将于 11 月 21 日全国上映，并于 10 月 26 日释出「开门见诡」版预告。影片由路阳、王红卫监制，侯逍遥执导，冯绍峰、陈雨锶、李梦领衔主演。郭月、车晓、周野芒、杨轶也将出演。

预告将故事放进一栋别墅：丁伯阳、马娅与万影三人暗中交锋，猜忌与危险不断升级，还有人在暗处窥探他们。
title_en: Lu Yang-Produced Thriller "The Probe" Sets November 21 Release with New Teaser
content_en:
The suspense film *The Probe* has announced its nationwide theatrical release for November 21, accompanied by a new trailer released on October 26. Executive produced by Lu Yang and Wang Hongwei and directed by Hou Xiaoyao, the film features a lead cast including Feng Shaofeng, Chen Yusi, and Li Meng.

Set inside a secluded villa, the story follows three main characters—Ding Boyang, Ma Ya, and Wan Ying—as they become entangled in a psychological clash of paranoia and mounting danger, unaware that a hidden observer is watching their every move from the shadows.
